note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 Package 2 affiliation evidence corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, evidence, acceptance, or release.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation implementation evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Version, commit, reviewed source, and dependency manifest.
evidence_requirements.affected_requirement: Inherited implementation governance and AEDOM-V12-001 intake capability.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Source written is not evidence accepted.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation build-provenance evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Reproducible build record bound to a reviewed commit.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Build succeeded is not deployment path proven.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation database-behaviour evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.required_evidence_classes: Automated test evidence; manual test evidence.
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Physical database state, version, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Schema exists is not database invariant proven.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation environment-qualification evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Environment qualification record and configuration baseline.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: An environment exists is not an environment representative.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation deployment-path evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Promotion record bound to a release candidate.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Build succeeded is not deployment path proven.
